readerCopy.body: A necessary change can still be blocked by the person or system controlling the money, access, information, or terms required to carry it out. When Pluto squares the North Node, power and forward movement create friction, making dependence itself part of the obstacle. More pressure is not always more leverage. The path becomes clearer once what can be withheld, which alternatives exist, and what would reduce dependence are identified before the struggle is allowed to define the entire future.
